title: The Suburbs Are Bleeding America Dry | Climate Town (feat. @NotJustBikes)
summary: A snarky, comedic video essay from Climate Town, with a guest appearance by Not Just Bikes, arguing that American suburban sprawl and single-family zoning are financially and environmentally unsustainable. It covers how zoning rules shape housing and what viewers can do locally, such as attending zoning meetings.
why: HN commenters cite it as an entertaining but well-sourced explainer on US zoning and housing costs whenever those topics come up.

quote.text: A funny, yet very well researched video on that exact same topic of Zoning nonsense. Entertaining AND informative.
